news.title: O'Neill School ready to shine at ARNOVA Conference
news.summary_en: O’Neill School faculty and doctoral students will share research at the 2026 ARNOVA Conference, advancing nonprofit, philanthropy, and civil society scholarship.

news.title: Study finds hydroclimate whiplash a growing problem in U.S.
news.summary_en: New O’Neill School research finds rapid shifts from drought to extreme rainfall are intensifying across the U.S., highlighting growing risks to communities and ecosystems.
